title: Don't Do RAG: When Cache-Augmented Generation is All You Need for Knowledge Tasks
selection_reason: 限定知識集合を長文脈へ事前ロードし実行状態をキャッシュして、検索遅延と検索誤りを避ける。
instructions: Read the primary source in full. Produce a repository-quality structured research record covering problem, novelty, method, evaluation conditions, key quantitative results, limitations, implementation status, and relation to existing repository lineages. A technically successful full-text fetch is not sufficient when tables, appendices, or other evidence needed for the five slots are missing; continue through the ordered official full-text routes and use the next route only to fill the missing primary evidence.
